claims.claim: Deep debugging: see exact event sequences and timing in recordings
Audio reconstruction: voice conversations can be exported as WAV files
Replay capability: recreate test runs with deterministic providers
Performance analysis: per-event timing and latency are available for analysis
Annotation support: labels, scores and comments can be added to recordings

kind value Arena for the arena config document
spec.defaults.output is a valid config block for arena defaults
output.dir field sets the output directory (example value out)
output.formats accepts json and markdown
output.recording.enabled is a boolean field that turns recording on
output.recording.dir field sets the recordings subdirectory
promptarena run --scenario <name> runs a single scenario
Recordings are saved to <output directory>/recordings/ as JSONL files
Each recording is a JSONL file whose first line is a metadata line
Each recording is a JSONL file followed by event lines
Metadata line example fields: type metadata, session_id, start_time, duration
Event line example fields: type event, timestamp, event_type
Session recordings capture a comprehensive event stream covering all runtime activity
conversation.started is emitted at session initialization and includes the system prompt
message.created is emitted for user and assistant messages with multimodal content parts
message.updated is emitted for metadata updates (latency, token counts, cost)
pipeline.started is emitted at pipeline start and includes the middleware count
pipeline.completed is emitted at pipeline completion with total cost and tokens
pipeline.failed is emitted on pipeline failure with the error
stage.started is emitted once per stage per turn with the stage name and type
stage.completed is emitted at stage completion with duration
stage.failed is emitted on stage failure with the error and duration
provider.call.started is emitted with provider, model and message count
provider.call.completed is emitted with tokens, cost and cached tokens
provider.call.failed is emitted on LLM API call failure with the error
tool.call.started is emitted at tool execution start with arguments
tool.call.completed is emitted with duration and status
tool.call.failed is emitted with the error and duration
tool.client.request is emitted for client-side tool requests with consent message and categories
validation.started is emitted at validator execution start
validation.passed is emitted on validation success with duration
validation.failed is emitted on validation failure with violations
context.built is emitted for context window assembly with token count, budget and truncation
context.token_budget_exceeded is emitted on token budget overflow with required vs budget
state.loaded is emitted when conversation state is loaded from the store
state.saved is emitted when conversation state is persisted
stream.interrupted is emitted on stream interruption with the reason
workflow.transitioned is emitted with from and to states, event and prompt task
workflow.completed is emitted on reaching a terminal state with final state and transition count
audio.input is emitted for user or environment audio chunks
audio.output is emitted for assistant audio chunks
audio.transcription is emitted with the speech-to-text transcription result
video.frame is emitted for video frame capture
image.input is emitted for image input from user or environment
image.output is emitted for image output from the agent
screenshot is emitted for screenshot capture
middleware.started, middleware.completed and middleware.failed appear only in recordings made before PromptKit replaced its middleware chain with pipeline stages
Current runs emit stage.* events instead of middleware.* events
The message.created event includes a Parts field of type []ContentPart
ContentPart Type value text carries a Text field
ContentPart Type value image carries a Media field with MIME type, URL or inline data
ContentPart Type value audio carries a Media field
ContentPart Type value video carries a Media field
Audio, video and image events use BinaryPayload for content storage
BinaryPayload has an InlineData field holding raw bytes for small payloads
BinaryPayload has a StorageReference field for externalized content
BinaryPayload has a MIMEType field (e.g. audio/pcm, image/png)
Audio events include AudioMetadata with sample rate, channels, encoding and duration
Video events include VideoMetadata with width, height and frame rate

A duplex recording holds audio.output events with inline audio/pcm payload, one per assistant audio chunk, and no user audio
A recording holds no stage, pipeline, tool or provider events, no audio.input, and no message.text.delta, image or video events
In a duplex run the recorder sits after the provider stage, which runs the pack guardrails, so a recorded assistant message holds the enforced content
An Arena recording holds exactly message.created, stream.interrupted and audio.output events; audio.output comes from duplex runs and from streaming text turns whose provider streams audio
